title: Apple Finally Gets AI Approval in China! 🇨🇳
body: Apple Finally Gets AI Approval in China! 🇨🇳
Chinese authorities have approved the launch of Apple Intelligence features in China, in partnership with Alibaba and Baidu — after a long wait in the approval process.
A move that could restore Apple's momentum in the world's largest smartphone market.
Do you use AI features on your phone every day? 🍏
